//: Ceilings for the single-file shells. Raise one IN THE COMMIT that needs the bytes, and say what bought them. Checked by scripts/test-spaces-size.mjs.

spaces.//: 200 KiB. All of M3 and M4 landed together — tables, media, link cards, comments, and export-page-as-space plus subtree import — measured 166,482 B before and 195,434 B after, +28,952 B for five features. That is the single largest step this shell has taken and it is the last of the roadmap's v0.1 content work, so the number should now go sideways rather than up. Zopfli is already applied; it is what kept this under 200. Headroom is deliberate: the shell is mostly one compressed block and the packer's output differs across node versions (one commit measured 130,095 B on node 26 locally and 131,246 B on CI node 24), so a tight ceiling fails in CI for no reason. CI is the number that counts. The right-hand properties panel then measured 196,950 B before and 203,598 B after (+6,648, 3.4%) for props.ts, its stylesheet and 21 strings in eight catalogs, so 200 KiB went to 208: 1,202 B of headroom is inside the packer's own cross-node spread and would have failed CI for no reason.
